title: Lock Code labels on default Transformation Rule records
summary: Transformation Rule record codes are now locked to prevent translation, ensuring configuration portability across differently-localized environments while keeping descriptions translatable.
key_points: Added Locked = true to 12 Code-producing labels used for default Transformation Rule records
Description labels stay translatable; only the primary-key codes are locked
Keeps rule codes like Uppercase identical across environments with different languages or translation extensions
Existing translated codes are not renamed; re-running default creation could add English-code rows alongside them
